A '''blumbush''' was a type of [[Plant/Legends|plant]] [[Homeworld/Legends|Native]] to the [[Forest/Legends|forest]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]. The blumbush produced [[Blumfruit/Legends|blumfruit]] which were used to make [[Blumfruit juice/Legends|juice]]. The [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] fermented the [[Fruit juice/Legends|fruit juice]] to produce a substace that acted as a both a disinfectant and a powerful adhesive.

==Biology and appearance==
Blumbush was a multi&ndash;trunk [[Plant/Legends|bush]]<ref name="Gungan Frontier" /> that could grow into a tall [[Tree/Legends|tree]]. [[Homeworld/Legends|Native]] to the [[Forest/Legends|forest]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]], the blumbush had [[Color/Legends|green]] leaves, a brown trunk and produced orange [[Blumfruit/Legends|blumfruit]].<ref name="Gungan Frontier" />

==History==
[[File:Blumbush_SWG.jpg|thumb|200px|A blumbush that has grown into a full tree.]]
The [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]],<ref name="Gungan Frontier" /> a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] also native to Endor, were fond of the tasty blumfruits produced by the blumbush.<ref name="Gungan Frontier" /> At somepoint between [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] and [[24 BBY/Legends|24 BBY]], <ref name="Gungan Frontier Date">The events of [[Star Wars Episode I: The Gungan Frontier|''Star Wars'' Episode I: ''The Gungan Frontier'']] occur after the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]] and while [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] is still the [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|Queen of Naboo]]. Since ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' dates the Battle of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] and Amidala't transition from [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] to [[Senator/Legends|senator]] to [[24 BBY/Legends|24 BBY]], the video game must take place between these two [[Standard year/Legends|years]].</ref> the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] gathered various [[Plant/Legends|plant]] and animial species&mdash;including the blumbush&mdash;from throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] in order to transform and colonization Naboo's empty [[Water/Legends|water]] moon, [[Ohma-D'un/Legends|Ohma-D'un]]. On the moon, the Gungans harvested the blumbush's [[Fruit/Legends|fruit]], [[fermented blumfruit juice|ferment]] the [[Blumfruit juice/Legends|blumfruit juice]], and used the resulting product as both a disinfectant and as a powerful adhesive.<ref name="Gungan Frontier" /> By [[1 ABY/Legends|ABY]],<ref name="SWG timeline">{{SWG timeline}}</ref> the [[Museum of Tatooine/Legends|Museum of Tatooine]] on the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] had a painting titled [[Blumbush (painting)|''Blumbush'']] on display. The painting depicted a grown blumbush tree and was produced by the [[Artist/Legends|artist]] [[Klepa Laeel]].<ref name="Galaxies">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Blumbush_concept_art.jpg|thumb|right|150px|Concept art for ''Star Wars Galaxies''.]]
The blumbush first appeared though unnamed in "[[Wicket's Wagon]]," the tenth episode of [[Ewoks: Season One|season one]] of the ''[[Ewoks (television series)|Ewoks]]'' animated television series.<ref name="Wicket's Wagon">{{Ewoks|Wicket's Wagon}}</ref> The episode aired on [[September 7]], [[1985]].<ref name="A Star Wars CELibration">{{InsiderCite|27|A Star Wars CELibration|A ''Star Wars'' CELibration}}</ref> The play was first identified as a blumbush in the [[1999]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Episode I: The Gungan Frontier|''Star Wars'' Episode I: ''The Gungan Frontier'']], developed and published by [[Lucas Learning]].<ref name="Gungan Frontier" />
